_doc: Curated Stanford-affiliated Bay to Breakers entries. Hand-edited. Two flavors: `registered_bibs` get joined against results.min.json for official chip data; `unregistered` are self-reported (Strava/GPS) for folks who didn't sign up for the actual race. Anyone can also add themselves on the page via localStorage; those entries are private to that browser. To promote a localStorage entry to the public list, paste it into `unregistered` and commit.
